# GFP, LLC

> GFP, LLC is an independent engineering consulting and building commissioning firm based in Hollidaysburg, Pennsylvania, led by Donald M. Goodman, P.E., LEED AP, BCxP, CEM. It provides engineering consulting, building commissioning, energy and performance optimization, geothermal / ground-source heat pump system design, and expert witness support for construction disputes.

Website: https://gfp-engineering.com/
Phone: (814) 312-8411
Email: donald.gfpllc@gmail.com
Office: Hollidaysburg, Pennsylvania, USA
Hours: Monday–Friday, 8 am–6 pm (Eastern)
Federal contracting: UEI JQXQD6KAQM39 · CAGE 17JM3. Bid, payment, and performance bonds available for qualifying projects.

## Services

- Engineering consulting: technical analysis, MEP design review, load analysis, feasibility studies, and peer review for commercial, institutional, and industrial facilities.
- Building commissioning: new-construction commissioning, retro-commissioning, functional testing, and commissioning authority services, following ASHRAE Guideline 0 and Standard 202.
- Energy and performance optimization: energy audits, measurement and verification, energy conservation measure (ECM) analysis, life-cycle cost analysis, and benchmarking.
- Geothermal and ground-source heat pump systems: borefield thermal modeling, borehole layout and sizing, delegated design, and engineer-of-record services.
- Expert witness and litigation support: independent technical opinions for construction disputes involving HVAC, mechanical, geothermal, and commissioning issues — early case assessment, document and site review, root-cause analysis, written expert and rebuttal reports, deposition testimony, and support for mediation and settlement.

## Systems covered

HVAC and mechanical (air and hydronic), building automation and controls (BAS/DDC), building envelope, lighting and daylighting controls, domestic and process water, electrical and power distribution, refrigeration and process cooling, life safety (smoke and fire), and geothermal closed-loop borefields.

## Markets

Education (K-12 and higher education), healthcare, government, laboratory, commercial, municipal, transportation, and mixed-use facilities.

## Principal: Donald M. Goodman, P.E.

- Professional Engineer licensed in Pennsylvania, New York, and Maryland.
- LEED Accredited Professional (USGBC); Building Commissioning Professional, BCxP (ASHRAE); Certified Energy Manager, CEM (AEE).
- M.Eng., Architectural Engineering (Mechanical), Pennsylvania State University; B.S., Mechanical Engineering, Pennsylvania State University.
- Primary Qualifying Agent for general contractor licenses in North Carolina, South Carolina, Louisiana, and Tennessee (Florida pending).
- More than 30 years of MEP design, commissioning, and construction management experience, including oversight of a $130M+ design and construction portfolio.
- Engineer of record for 18+ geothermal heat pump systems, primarily for K-12 schools and colleges in Pennsylvania, Maryland, and Virginia.
- Holder of U.S. Patent No. 6,946,593 for HVAC system innovation.
- Member of ASHRAE and AEE; former President of the ASHRAE Johnstown Chapter; frequent speaker at green building and facilities conferences.
- Has served as a retained expert on construction disputes, providing written expert opinions and deposition testimony.
